text: A paper-airplane receipt folds differently for each proof, so a parent can see the whole test trip in one shape.
rationale: Each fold carries a worker's tiny evidence without asking the next person to redo it.

text: A magic mailbox spits out a red marble only when two workers tell the same story about a repair.
rationale: The marble is a physical agreement signal instead of another repeated inspection.

text: A puzzle lock has four teeth for route, custody, testing, and acceptance; the finished box cannot close with a missing tooth.
rationale: One glance at the closed box shows every required proof traveled with the work.

text: A tiny shoebox museum keeps each failed fix beside its fixed twin, so the next worker can avoid the same hole.
rationale: Past mistakes stay visible at the repair bench rather than being rediscovered.

text: A talking stopwatch wakes the parent only when the same error appears twice, then plays both little recordings.
rationale: Repeated work becomes a recognizable echo with its original clues attached.

text: Workers pass one glowing pebble that changes color at each handoff and goes dark if anyone opens the work without adding proof.
rationale: The pebble makes ownership and proof movement visible in one object.
